g.title: enter
g.text: Tracking mode: process one HC result

g.title: choose
g.text: Prefer center; a side must improve
the current best distance by more than 2 cm

g.title: reset
g.text: Miss count = 0; restore offset to 8 degrees
Start the next LEFT / RIGHT / CENTER cycle

g.title: recover
g.text: Stay in Track and expand the probe offset
Start another cycle around the last center
